topics.topic: A13 rule-5 semantics for service_unreachable during resume, including whether processing continues past an element that now needs owner approval
questions: During one resume call, if an earlier service_unreachable element now switches to owner_approval (no valid authority), must resume continue processing later service_unreachable elements or stop immediately?
Does 'owner's resolution' apply only to outcome_unknown, or also to service_unreachable elements?

topics.topic: After not_applied, whether resend can be authorized by standing grant or always requires fresh owner approval
questions: After `not_applied`, is a standing grant ever allowed to authorize the resend, or is fresh owner approval always mandatory?

topics.topic: Exact A05 structural-validation fault set and whether those faults are enforced at composition, proof, or both (including map_over and malformed node fields)
questions: Must proof also refuse when `map_over` names a non-existent input, names an input that is not `one`, or is present even though no `many -> one` feed exists?

What exact set is "every other structural fault" for composition vs proof, especially for malformed node fields (for example both `contract_version_id` and `binding_id`, neither of them, or `kind` mismatch)?

topics.topic: Exact pre-send failure path/status when selected instance has duplicated required headers
questions: At send time (including read operations), if required headers are duplicated in the selected instance, which exact pre-send failure path is normative?

topics.topic: Normative grammar/parser for path placeholders and what syntax is invalid
questions: What exact parser/grammar defines path placeholders and invalid placeholder syntax?

topics.topic: Precedence of A01 purpose check versus other checks when creating the first version in a new slot/flow
questions: If a first contract for a new slot is missing purpose and also fails an A02 contract condition, which refusal must be returned first?
When composing the first version of a new flow, if purpose is missing and structural faults also exist, which failure is reported?

topics.topic: Required node status/outcome when runtime output contains non-JCS-representable values
questions: When runtime output contains a non-JCS value (e.g., NaN/Infinity), which node status/outcome must be recorded?

topics.topic: Retry policy for invalid token-list re-reads: revalidate on every request vs only after file-byte changes
questions: After a re-read fails validation (parse error, short token, duplicate token) and file bytes then remain unchanged but readable, does the kernel attempt a full re-read/validation on every request, or only when bytes change again?

topics.topic: When multiple referenced records are unknown in one request, which unknown reference is reported as the refusal cause
questions: If one request references multiple records (for example flow + version, run + approval) and more than one is unknown, which reference must be reported as the refusal cause?

topics.topic: Which manifest structural/type faults count as manifest mismatch and exactly where that check sits in first-failure ordering
questions: Which additional manifest structural/type faults must be treated as manifest mismatch, and at which exact check position in the "first failing" order?
